title: STAGEET：用于语法纠错的分阶段类型化编辑标注框架（以阿拉伯语为例）
summary: STAGEET提出一种分阶段类型化编辑标注框架，将Seq2Edit监督重组为可执行的类型化阶段，每个阶段预测自身标签空间并重写句子，支持校正类别。在QALB-2014和ZAEBUC上保持竞争性能，并在QALB-2014上达到最新最优结果，同时提供更可检查的校正轨迹。
summary_en: STAGEET proposes a stage-wise typed edit-tagging framework for grammatical error correction, reorganizing Seq2Edit supervision into typed executable stages with category-aware labels. It achieves state-of-the-art results on QALB-2014 while providing more inspectable correction trajectories.
